chart.title: Cashflow by Cycle by InOut in the last 13 cycles

search.query: index="cashflow-1.1" | where Cycle >= strftime(now() - 3600 * 24 * (365 + 31), "%y%m") | lookup Constant-Routes.csv Route OUTPUT Cash as is_cash | where is_cash="TRUE" | lookup Constant-Categories.csv Category OUTPUT InOut AS in_out | eval InOut = if(isNull(in_out), if(Amount>0, "IN", "OUT"), in_out) | eval adjustedAmount = if(InOut="OUT", -Amount, Amount) | chart sum(adjustedAmount) as SubTotal by Cycle, InOut | sort Cycle

chart.title: Cashflow in OUT in $cycle$ by Category

search.query: index="cashflow-1.1" | where Cycle="$cycle$" | lookup Constant-Routes.csv Route OUTPUT Cash as is_cash | where is_cash="TRUE" | lookup Constant-Categories.csv Category OUTPUT InOut AS in_out | eval InOut = if(isNull(in_out), "ERR", in_out) | where InOut="OUT" | eval adjustedAmount = -Amount | chart sum(adjustedAmount) as SubTotal by Category | sort SubTotal DESC

index="cashflow-1.1" | where Cycle="$cycle$" | lookup Constant-Routes.csv Route OUTPUT Cash as is_cash | where is_cash="TRUE" | where ("$category$" = "ALL") OR ("$category$" = Category) | lookup Constant-Categories.csv Category OUTPUT InOut AS in_out | eval InOut = if(isNull(in_out), "ERR", in_out) | where ("$inOut$" = "ALL") OR ("$inOut$" = InOut) | eval FDate = strftime(strptime('Date', "%m/%d/%y"), "%m/%d/%y") | table FDate Amount, Description, Category, Route, Memo, Cycle, InOut | sort FDate
